# Calluna xylem cleaning

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: libraries
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(readxl) # Pour lire Excel
library(writexl)  # Pour écrire Excel
library(dplyr)
library(openxlsx)
```

## Import data for 2025

```{r}
#| label: import 2025

# Import all the files containing the results for xylem area
files_2025 <- list.files("Data/results_xylem_area_2025_Eirik", 
                    full.names = TRUE)

# Merging all file into one database
combined_results_2025 <- readr::read_delim(file = files_2025,id = "file")
# Naming xylem_id column
names(combined_results_2025)[2] <- "xylem_id"

# Extract information from the filename 
combined_results_2025_clean <- combined_results_2025 %>%
  mutate(
    source_file = tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file)),
    dir =dirname(file)  # directory name for the year
  ) %>%
  separate_wider_delim(
    source_file,
    delim = "-",
    names = c(
      "age_class",
      "nin_rep",
      "direction",
      "SUBSET",
      "subset"
    ),
    cols_remove = FALSE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    nin_type = stringr::str_extract(nin_rep, "^[A-Za-z]+"),
    replicate = stringr::str_extract(nin_rep, "[0-9]+$")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    plant = paste(age_class, nin_rep, sep = "-"),
    treatment = paste(age_class, nin_type, sep = "-"),
    plant_direction = paste(age_class, nin_rep, direction, sep = "-"),
    subset_id = paste(age_class, nin_rep, direction, subset, sep = "-")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    year = stringr::str_extract(dir, "\\d{4}"),
    observer = as.character("ES"),
    age_class = factor(
      age_class, 
      levels = c("PIO", "BUI", "MAT")
      ),
    nin_type = factor(
      nin_type,
      levels = c("BH", "FH", "TH"))
  ) %>%
  select(
    year,
    source_file,
    plant,
    age_class,
    nin_type,
    replicate,
    treatment,
    plant_direction,
    subset,
    subset_id,
    everything(),
    -file,
    -replicate,
    -direction,
    -SUBSET,
    -nin_rep
  )

# Make Year Categorical
combined_results_2025$year <- as.character("2025")

```

## Subsample area 2024
Import results for subsamples area

```{r}
#| label: Subsample area

# Import all files containing results for subsample area
files_subsample_area_2024 <- list.files("Data/subsample_area_2024", 
                    full.names = TRUE)

# Merging all file into one database
subsample_area_2024 <- readr::read_delim(file = files_subsample_area_2024,id = "file")

names(subsample_area_2024)[2] <- "subset"

# Create subset_id identical to the column in the dataset of the results
subsample_area_2024_area <- subsample_area_2024 %>%
  mutate(
    source_file = tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    subset_id = paste(source_file, subset, sep = "-"),
    subset_area = Area
  ) %>%
  select(
    source_file,
    subset_id,
    subset,
    subset_area,
    -file
  )

# Functions to correct the order for the subset area
swap_subset_area <- function(data, id, subset1, subset2, subset3) {

  area_1 <- data$subset_area[
    data$source_file == id &
      data$subset == subset1
  ]
  
  area_2 <- data$subset_area[
    data$source_file == id &
      data$subset == subset2
  ]
  
  area_3 <- data$subset_area[
    data$source_file == id &
      data$subset == subset3
  ]

  data$subset_area[
    data$source_file == id &
      data$subset == 1
  ] <- area_1

  data$subset_area[
    data$source_file == id &
      data$subset == 2
  ] <- area_2
  
  data$subset_area[
    data$source_file == id &
      data$subset == 3
  ] <- area_3

  data
} # Place subset in the order established
swap_subset_area_2 <- function(data, id, subset1, subset2) {

  temp <- data$subset_area[
    data$source_file == id &
      data$subset == subset1
  ]

  data$subset_area[
    data$source_file == id &
      data$subset == subset1
  ] <- data$subset_area[
    data$source_file == id &
      data$subset == subset2
  ]

  data$subset_area[
    data$source_file == id &
      data$subset == subset2
  ] <- temp

  data
} # Swap to subset area together 

# Function application to obtain the correct order
subsample_area_2024_area <- swap_subset_area(subsample_area_2024_area, "BUI-BH1-N", 3, 2, 1)
subsample_area_2024_area <- swap_subset_area(subsample_area_2024_area, "BUI-BH1-S", 3, 2, 1)
subsample_area_2024_area <- swap_subset_area(subsample_area_2024_area, "BUI-BH4-S", 3, 2, 1)
subsample_area_2024_area <- swap_subset_area(subsample_area_2024_area, "BUI-BH5-N", 3, 2, 1)
subsample_area_2024_area <- swap_subset_area(subsample_area_2024_area, "BUI-BH5-S", 1, 3, 2)
subsample_area_2024_area <- swap_subset_area(subsample_area_2024_area, "BUI-BH7-N", 3, 1, 2)
subsample_area_2024_area <- swap_subset_area(subsample_area_2024_area, "BUI-BH7-S", 3, 2, 1)
subsample_area_2024_area <- swap_subset_area(subsample_area_2024_area, "BUI-FH1-N", 2, 1, 3)
subsample_area_2024_area <- swap_subset_area(subsample_area_2024_area, "BUI-FH1-S", 2, 3, 1)
subsample_area_2024_area <- swap_subset_area(subsample_area_2024_area, "BUI-FH2-N", 3, 1, 2)
subsample_area_2024_area <- swap_subset_area(subsample_area_2024_area, "BUI-FH2-S", 1, 3, 2)
subsample_area_2024_area <- swap_subset_area(subsample_area_2024_area, "BUI-FH3-S", 3, 2, 1)
subsample_area_2024_area <- swap_subset_area(subsample_area_2024_area, "BUI-FH4-N", 3, 2, 1)
subsample_area_2024_area <- swap_subset_area(subsample_area_2024_area, "BUI-FH4-S", 2, 3, 1)
subsample_area_2024_area <- swap_subset_area(subsample_area_2024_area, "BUI-FH5-N", 2, 1, 3)
subsample_area_2024_area <- swap_subset_area(subsample_area_2024_area, "BUI-FH5-S", 2, 3, 1)
subsample_area_2024_area <- swap_subset_area(subsample_area_2024_area, "BUI-TH3-N", 3, 1, 2)
subsample_area_2024_area <- swap_subset_area(subsample_area_2024_area, "BUI-TH3-S", 2, 3, 1)

subsample_area_2024_area <- swap_subset_area(subsample_area_2024_area, "BUI-TH5-S", 3, 2, 1)

subsample_area_2024_area <- swap_subset_area(subsample_area_2024_area, "MAT-TH1-N", 3, 1, 2)
```

## Damage 2024

```{r}
#| label: Damage

damage_2024 <- read_excel("Data/damage_report_2024.xlsx")

damage_2024 <- damage_2024 %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("damage_sub"), as.numeric))

damage_2024_long <- damage_2024 %>%
  select(image_id, whole_plant_damage, cardinal_damage, folds, warped, late_season_missing,
         damage_sub1, damage_sub2, damage_sub3) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("damage_sub"),
    names_to = "subset",
    values_to = "subset_damage"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    subset = sub("damage_sub", "", subset),
    subset = as.integer(subset),
    plant_direction = image_id
  )

xylem_data_2024 <- xylem_data_2024 %>%
  mutate(subset = as.integer(subset))

xylem_data_2024 <- xylem_data_2024 %>%
  left_join(
    damage_2024_long,
    by = c("plant_direction", "subset")
  )

write.csv(df, "Output/list_images_cut_and_merge.csv")
```
